get_source_dir: get the absolute path of the directory where the gmock test .py files are located
get_test_executable_path: get the absolute path of a gmock test binary given its executable name
get_exit_status: get the exit status code from an os.system command result across platforms
run_subprocess: run a subprocess command and capture its output using the gmock Subprocess utility
set_env_var: set an environment variable using the gmock SetEnvVar utility for test configuration
